scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Quality Upgradation / Certification: Support for Eco-Certification / Organic Certification
other_conditions: Applicants must be SHGs/collectives of tribal (ST) coffee growers.
Certification must be for estates under standards such as Organic, Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance, UTZ Certified, Bird friendly/ Shade grown, or any equivalent program.
For organic certification, applicants must be certified as per NPOP standards (or equivalent international standards such as EU Regulation, NOP, JAS).
Certificates must be obtained from agencies accredited by the respective certification programmes during the MTF period.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of 75% of the certification cost (up to 3 years for organic certification, 1 year for other eco‑certifications) to eligible SHGs/collectives of tribal coffee growers.
